answer: Tie withdrawal rights to a lantern beacon that lights only after an agent files a randomly assigned, human-reviewable report each epoch. Reviewers compare it against a hidden reference, and any mismatch emits a signal that freezes payouts until a second reviewer clears it. Every identity also posts an anchor asset with a distinct origin, so a farm cannot recycle one deposit across many wallets. Mass registration therefore demands repeated genuine reporting, independent review and unique collateral, far costlier than hiring one honest agent.
